packageRules.description: Auto-merge once the full CI matrix (multi-arch image build + every backend integration test) passes - merging to main doesn't release anything, releases are still cut manually by tagging a version.
Major version bumps get a human look before merging - API/behavior breaks aren't always caught by tests.

Keep Spring Boot, the Spring Cloud train, and Spring Cloud Config in a single PR - Boot's version is dictated by whichever Cloud train is in use, and project.version is derived from spring-cloud-config, so all three must move together. Merging this is effectively the signal that a release is ready to be cut, so it always stays manual.
